entities.name: Jagun Wingmate
entities.description: A Mardu orc warrior who helps others in battle rather than claiming glory, and becomes one of Alesha's bodyguards.

entities.name: Alesha
entities.description: A Mardu warrior named for her grandmother, who earns the battle name Alesha, Who Smiles at Death, and leads her followers after the dragon Kolaghan.

entities.name: Mardu
entities.description: The warrior clan of the steppe that fights dragons and follows Alesha.

entities.name: Kolaghan
entities.description: A dragon described as the fastest thing that lived and the shadow of death, which passes by Alesha and her bodyguards without attacking.

entities.name: Gedruk Wingbreaker
entities.description: A Mardu warrior who hacks at a dragon's neck after Jagun holds back.

entities.name: Kuru Vashar
entities.description: A Mardu warrior whom Jagun helped when she fell beneath a dragon.

entities.name: Margan Backbreaker
entities.description: A Mardu warrior whom Jagun shielded from a dragon's claw.

entities.name: Jalasha Impaler
entities.description: A Mardu warrior whose life Jagun saved by throwing himself onto a dragon's head.

entities.name: Khanfall
entities.description: The fall of the clans' khans on Tarkir, after which Jagun joined Alesha in following Kolaghan.

events.summary: Alesha wounds a dragon and Jagun knocks its head back, but then hesitates to deliver a killing blow.
events.quote: Alesha wounded one by letting her blade bite deep into its flank

events.summary: Instead of killing the dragon, Jagun slashes its foreclaw to protect another fighter, and Gedruk Wingbreaker strikes the neck.
events.quote: It was Gedruk Wingbreaker who ran forward and hacked at the creature's neck before it could regain its balance.

events.summary: Alesha asks Jagun why he held back and kills a second dragon as it lunges at him.
events.quote: Alesha commanded Jagun to step forth, asking him why he held back.

events.summary: Alesha tells Jagun to show her who he is, and he returns to battle where he fights by making openings for others.
events.quote: He wasn't looking for the killing blow, but he made it possible for others.

events.summary: Alesha learns Jagun has fought nine battles without claiming glory and calls him a fool for not knowing himself.
events.quote: He had fought in nine but had not claimed any glories in any of them.

events.summary: Warriors testify that Jagun saved Kuru Vashar, Margan Backbreaker and Jalasha Impaler during the battle.
events.quote: Jalasha Impaler said Jagun had saved her life

events.summary: Alesha names Jagun a hero of many battles and gives him the right to choose.
events.quote: As a hero of many battles, she gave him the right to choose once he realized his worth.

events.summary: Jagun names Alesha 'Who Smiles at Death' and the Mardu shout her name.
events.quote: he named her Alesha, Who Smiles at Death.

events.summary: Jagun names himself Wingmate and Alesha makes him one of her bodyguards.
events.quote: Alesha named him as one of her bodyguards.

events.summary: Kolaghan approaches Alesha and Jagun on the steppe, then lets them pass without attacking.
Alesha discards the Mardu banner, declares that Kolaghan does not want to lead, and rides after the dragon with both bodyguards.
events.quote: She told her two bodyguards that Kolaghan did not want to lead and that her people did not have to kneel.

relations.quote: Alesha named him as one of her bodyguards.
Jagun Wingmate was a Mardu warrior before the Khanfall of Tarkir
